description: Complete compact JSON, at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes. Propose safe BOSS task actions matching the owner's prompt, or an empty actions array when answering a question or when no task mutation should occur.

summary.description: Concise human-readable summary or answer (1-1200 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL).

task_ref.description: For create_task: new unique lowercase slug ID (^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$). For all other ops: target existing task numeric ID as string (e.g. "2") or explicit ID (e.g. "m1-auth"), or an id created earlier in this actions list.

title.description: Single-line task title (1-200 chars, no newlines) for create_task and update_task_spec; null for other ops.

specification.description: Concise Markdown specification body (1-8000 UTF-8 bytes) for create_task and update_task_spec; null for other ops.

acceptance.description: 1-12 measurable acceptance criteria (1-500 UTF-8 bytes each) for create_task and update_task_spec; null for other ops.

depends_on.description: 0-32 explicit task IDs or numeric task IDs that this task depends on for create_task and update_task_spec; null for other ops.

reason.description: Nonblank reason or comment (1-1000 UTF-8 bytes) for add_task_note, block_task, needs_input_task, and cancel_task; null for other ops.
